title: Dismiss Crosstab export dialog after PDF export
observed_behavior: Export Crosstab -> PDF writes a PDF file to downloads, but the Export Crosstab dialog remains visible instead of dismissing after the export completes.
intended_behavior: PDF export should behave like the other Crosstab export types: write the file and then close the Export Crosstab dialog.
cause_summary: The async PDF export branch completed file generation but did not reliably clear the export dialog state after download completion.
fix_summary: The export handler now closes the dialog in a shared `finally` path so PDF dismisses the same way as CSV JSON and XLSX.
notes: Validated green by the maintained Crosstab export spec on the stable local server after the fix landed.

title: Add Crosstab to File Settings launch options
observed_behavior: The File Settings `View to Launch` select does not include `Crosstab`, so uploaded datasets cannot launch directly into Crosstab from the pre-launch settings flow.
intended_behavior: File Settings should expose `Crosstab` as a valid launch target and allow uploaded datasets to open directly into an interactive Crosstab.
cause_summary: The File Settings default-view select omitted Crosstab and the Newick launch path later reset widgets back to defaults which clobbered the requested direct-launch view.
fix_summary: Crosstab was added to the File Settings launch select and the redundant Newick `resetData()` call that reverted `default-view` mid-launch was removed.
notes: Validated green by the maintained six-format direct-launch Crosstab journey after the launch path fixes landed.

title: Refresh Crosstab cluster columns after threshold change
observed_behavior: When Crosstab is already open on the default cluster-vs-None view and Minimum Cluster Size is raised from 1 to 3, the rendered table keeps stale cluster columns from the pre-filter state. In the repro, the visible network drops cluster `1`, but the open Crosstab header still shows `0, 1, 2, Total`.
intended_behavior: An open Crosstab should recompute immediately after filtering or reclustering changes visible cluster membership, so hidden clusters disappear from the rendered columns and totals stay aligned with the visible graph.
cause_summary: Crosstab was not subscribed to the same active-view `networkUpdated` refresh path used by other visualization tabs, so filter-driven visibility changes could leave the open table stale.
fix_summary: Crosstab now refreshes from session state on active `networkUpdated` events and when the tab becomes visible again, so filter-driven cluster changes rebuild the rendered table immediately.
notes: Validated green by the maintained uploaded refresh journey after the active-view refresh fix landed.

title: Keep Crosstab isolated from timeline checkpoints
observed_behavior: With Crosstab open on the uploaded COVID timeline fixture, enabling Timeline and moving to the June 28 2021 checkpoint rebuilt the rendered header body and footer from the timeline-visible node subset, even though Crosstab is not a timeline-target view.
intended_behavior: Timeline checkpoints should change the global metrics and the Bubble Map and 2D datasets only. Crosstab should continue aggregating the non-timeline filtered node dataset while it remains open.
cause_summary: Crosstab built its table from `getVisibleNodes()`, so the timeline node-visibility gate leaked directly into the Crosstab dataset.
fix_summary: Crosstab now uses the timeline-ignoring node getter, and the maintained isolation journey proves the rendered table stays equal to the pre-timeline baseline while global metrics change.
